issues.legal_issue: The inclusion of previously paid royalty and contributions to the District Mineral Foundation and National Mineral Exploration Trust in the sale value used to calculate royalty is not shown to be beyond the rule-making authority or contrary to statute, and the court deferred a final determination of whether the resulting cascading effect is manifestly arbitrary under Article 14.

The different treatment of coal and other minerals in calculating royalty is not arbitrary merely because their calculation methods differ, although the court directed the authorities to reconsider the acknowledged anomaly.
